lines.text: Because Luffy's fruit turned out to be the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika.
Here's my read: Shanks didn't steal a rare snack. He knew it mattered.

lines.text: The strongest counter is that every pirate would panic over a priceless fruit.

lines.text: Accident or plan, Shanks knew whose hands that fruit landed in.

title: Shanks Knew What Luffy Ate In Chapter 1
description: Shanks stole the Gomu Gomu no Mi from the World Government, then panicked when Luffy ate it. Here's my read on why that panic doesn't look like a man losing treasure. Do you think Shanks knew about Nika?
